propositions: Add a backend field to ReconcilerConfig defaulting to "jira", read as config.reconciler.backend, mirroring jira_cli_timeout.

Register a constrained _as_choice coercer for reconciler.backend so an unknown value is rejected at config-load with a ConfigError naming allowed keys, and an env override REBAR_RECONCILER_BACKEND resolves.
Add an in-tree registry module with a register decorator, a select_backend(config) resolver, and a test-only _reset_registry_for_test context manager.
JiraBackend is registered via @register("jira", ...) and imported as a side-effect through adapters/__init__.py so select_backend can resolve it.
select_backend returns a Backend whose transport is an AcliClient built from the same resolve_jira_settings() values as today's direct construction; unknown keys raise a registry error.
No existing consumer (_load_acli, AcliClient construction sites, differ/apply) is rewired — selection is isolated and deferred to a later story.
